data.note: Shared host, fixed CPU24, alternating pair order; five rounds per header. These are local regression observations, not a speedup claim.

timings.notes: Five alternating-order batches of twenty iterations per header, pinned to CPU24 on a shared host. Median current/baseline ratios: zlib 0.9930, zstd 0.9928, SQLite 0.9990, libgit2 1.0003. Bounded regression evidence, not a general speed claim.

limits: Ordinary undeclared C11 library names remain errors; C90 library admission is separate

GNU identifier-list builtin definitions and special block extern under a same-named internal object remain unsupported
